from: Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling \u2014 to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.
to: 重试之间的最大等待时间，单位毫秒。当提供商要求我们等待超过此值时，且没有凭据或模型回退成功，请求会快速失败而不是休眠（例如 Anthropic 的 3 小时速率限制窗口）。0 表示禁用上限 — 让会话按提供商声明的配额重置自动恢复/Maximum wait between retries, in ms. When the provider asks us to wait longer than this and no credential or model fallback succeeds, the request fails fast instead of sleeping (e.g. 3-hour Anthropic rate-limit windows). 0 disables the ceiling \u2014 to let the session auto-resume through provider-stated quota resets.

from: Inference backend for local tiny models (titles + memory): an ONNX execution provider, or `mlx` to download MLX weights and run them through mlx-lm on Apple silicon. Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

Default uses CPU-only ONNX. The PI_TINY_DEVICE env var overrides this.

from: ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.
to: 本地微型模型的 ONNX 量化/精度。默认使用每个模型自带的 dtype（q4）；精度越低速度越快，越高则越忠实。MLX 后端会忽略此项（其仓库已预量化为 4 位）。环境变量 PI_TINY_DTYPE 可覆盖此项/ONNX quantization/precision for local tiny models. Default uses each model's shipped dtype (q4); lower precision is faster, higher is more faithful. Ignored by the MLX backend (its repos are pre-quantized 4-bit). The PI_TINY_DTYPE env var overrides this.
